rules.name: User temporary files
rules.description: Files that programs left in the user's Temp folder. Only files older than 24 hours are removed.

rules.name: Windows temporary files
rules.description: System-wide temporary files in the Windows Temp folder. Only files older than 24 hours are removed.

rules.name: Windows Error Reporting files
rules.description: Crash and problem reports collected by Windows. They are only useful for sending to Microsoft.

rules.name: User error reports and crash dumps
rules.description: Per-user problem reports and application crash dumps.

rules.name: System memory dumps
rules.description: Dumps written after blue screens and driver failures. Only needed to diagnose old crashes.

rules.name: Thumbnail and icon cache
rules.description: Explorer rebuilds thumbnails and icons on demand. Files in use by Explorer are skipped.

rules.name: Windows internet cache
rules.description: Web cache used by Windows components and legacy apps.

rules.name: Store app temporary files
rules.description: Web cache and temporary files of Microsoft Store apps. App data and settings are not touched.

rules.name: Windows Update download cache
rules.description: Update packages that were already downloaded. Windows Update services are stopped while cleaning and started again. Skipped while an update waits for a restart.

rules.name: Old Windows log files
rules.description: Setup, servicing and diagnostic logs older than 7 days.
